evidence.summary: README describes the app as contacts, a deals pipeline and CSV reports, and says most of src/ is generated plumbing.
create_contact(name, email, company=None) inserts a row into the contacts table.
search_contacts(text) queries contacts with 'name like ? or email like ?' using the same text for both.
merge_duplicates(keep_id, drop_id) reassigns deals from drop_id to keep_id, then deletes the dropped contact; its docstring also claims notes are moved, but no code or table for notes exists.
contacts table: id integer primary key, name text not null, email text unique, company text.
deals table: id integer primary key, contact_id references contacts(id), title text, value_cents integer, stage text.
STAGES is a fixed tuple: lead, qualified, proposal, won, lost.
move_deal(deal_id, stage) raises ValueError('unknown stage') for a stage outside STAGES, otherwise updates the deal's stage.
export_csv(path, what='deals') writes every row of the named table to a CSV file with csv.writer, with no header row.
The shared table(name) helper used by every feature module only raises NotImplementedError: the persistence layer is a stub.
package.json names megacrm-ui with dependencies react ^18.2.0 and lodash ^4.17.21; no UI source files are present in the indexed tree.

Sample generated file: docstring 'Generated plumbing ... no user-facing behaviour', five integer constants and an identity handler; all 400 gen_* files match this template exactly (checked by a full-text pattern match).

frontend: React 18 (declared in package.json only; no UI source present)
database: SQL schema files (SQLite-style 'integer primary key'); engine not configured

architecture.frontend: Declared React UI package (megacrm-ui) with no source in the repository; dist/bundle.js is an empty placeholder (skipped by the indexer as generated).
architecture.backend: Python feature modules (contacts, deals, reports) over a shared table() helper that is a stub; no HTTP layer, no service process.

features.name: Contact management
features.description: Create contacts (name, email, optional company) and search them by name or email.
features.observed_behaviour: create_contact inserts a contact; search_contacts runs a LIKE query on name or email with the caller's text as given (no wildcards are added).
features.business_logic: name is required; email is unique; search matches name OR email.
features.integration: Needs persistence (the shared table helper is a stub).

features.name: Merge duplicate contacts
features.description: Merge two contacts: the kept contact takes over the dropped contact's deals and the dropped contact is deleted.
features.observed_behaviour: Updates deals.contact_id from drop_id to keep_id, then deletes drop_id. No transaction is visible; notes mentioned in the docstring are not handled.
features.business_logic: Destructive: the dropped contact row is deleted; fields of the dropped contact are not merged into the kept one.
features.integration: Needs persistence with transactions in the unified app.

features.name: Deals pipeline (fixed stages)
features.description: Deals linked to a contact, with a title and value in cents, moved through five fixed stages.
features.observed_behaviour: move_deal rejects any stage outside lead, qualified, proposal, won, lost with ValueError and otherwise sets the stage. Any stage may move to any other.
features.business_logic: Stages fixed in code; no transition rules; value stored as integer cents.

features.name: CSV export
features.description: Export all contacts or all deals to a CSV file.
features.observed_behaviour: export_csv reads every row of the named table and writes it to the given path; default is deals; no header row; table name is taken from the caller.
features.business_logic: Whole-table export, no filters; 'what' selects the table.
features.integration: Needs persistence and a file download or storage location.

error_handling.case: move a deal to an unknown stage

error_handling.behaviour: NotImplementedError from the stub table() helper

unknowns: Authentication and roles: no auth code exists in the repository; the unified app must define them.
User interface: package.json declares a React UI, but no UI source is present and dist/bundle.js is an empty placeholder; screens and navigation cannot be determined from the code.
Real persistence: src/shared/db.py is a stub, so the database engine and query semantics (e.g. whether search adds wildcards) are not known.
Contact notes: the merge docstring mentions notes but no notes entity or code exists; whether notes were planned is unknown.
